# Vendored scripts

`dicebear.js` is generated by `npm run build:avatars` (esbuild, from `scripts/avatars.mjs`): DiceBear's core and its Lorelei avatar style, bundled into one offline ES module. Do not edit it by hand; change the versions in `package.json` and rebuild.

## @dicebear/core 9.4.3 and @dicebear/lorelei 9.4.2

- Source: https://github.com/dicebear/dicebear (https://www.dicebear.com)
